description: Department of Labour - Notifying that the Cost of Living Index Number for the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade for the Month of January 2016 being 113.3, the Special Allowance in respect of a normal working day in the Month of February, 2016 will be Rs. 637.77
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers in specific trades based on the Cost of Living Index Number. It is issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance and relates to public sector service conditions and benefits, specifically addressing wage adjustments for workers. This falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it concerns public sector service administration and worker benefits.
